title: Traces of My Sister
next_chapter_hook: The secret passage entrance bears Chen Nian's handwritten inscription: 'Brother, I'll be waiting for you on the fourth page.' These words act like a key, about to unlock the forbidden gate sealed for ten thousand years.

text.content:
The residual spiritual energy from ten thousand years ago surged like a tide. My fingers remained pressed against the ancient stone tablet, a tingling sensation radiating through my fingertips. The mark of the Tianji Record on my brow ached faintly, as the fragment was frantically devouring my Heavenly Fate Value, attempting to decipher the ancient information contained within this stone tablet.

My breath quickened, and blurred images began flickering across my vision—yet those images were too fragmented, as if deliberately disrupted by some unseen force. I suddenly realized this was an aftereffect of Chen Nian's presence. The moment her name appeared in any prophecy, this damned resonance would be triggered.

'Number Forty-Nine...' I murmured, repeating this name, and unease sprouted wildly in my heart like weeds. Chess pieces laid ten thousand years ago, a scheme spanning across millennia—these words coiled around my heart like a curse.

The Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out from the Void, carrying a rare gravity: 'This object was not left by me. Over ten thousand years ago, when the Tianji Record was still complete, someone used immense power to divide it, and one part... drifted elsewhere.'

dialogue.content: 'Young Master, this place is not suitable for lingering,' Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted uncertainly. 'That Number Forty-Nine... might have some connection to the person you seek. But this is not the moment for revelation.'

text.content:
I ignored Mo Xiansheng's warning, my eyes fixed死死 on the nearly effaced small characters at the bottom of the stone tablet. When my fingertips touched those characters again, a familiar spiritual fluctuation that made my heart race pulsed through my fingertips—

This was Chen Nian's aura.

I abruptly raised my head, looking around. The stone chamber was deep and幽暗, the firelight flickering, everywhere filled with residual prohibitions and formation patterns from ten thousand years ago. Yet in this死寂, I clearly sensed a thread of vitality—a trace that only someone bound to me by bloodline could leave.

'Niànniàn...' I whispered her name, my throat tightening slightly. Three years.整整 three years, tracking leads about the Holy Sect, scheming within the three major sects, enduring humiliation while hiding my true abilities—everything I did was to find her.

And now, she had once been so close to me.

My fists unconsciously clenched, my knuckles cracking. Heavenly Fate Value was rapidly depleting, and the Tianji Record's foresight ran wild like an uncontrolled horse, but I couldn't afford to care about those things.

I began searching along the four walls of the stone chamber, my movements近乎疯狂. Chen Nian was a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—her very existence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight. But this also meant—if she wanted to leave information only I could understand, she had to use the most primitive methods.

After a incense stick's time, I discovered the first carving in a crack in the stone chamber's southeast corner.

It was a half-bloomed plum blossom, with an extremely small '念' character carved on the petals. The brushwork was稚嫩 yet steady—a unique style formed when I personally taught her to write.

dialogue.content: Just as I hesitated, a transmission talisman pierced through the air. I crushed the talisman, and Su Qingyao's cold voice rang out: 'Chen Ji, I've tracked a Holy Sect squad entering the western side of the ruins. They seem to be searching for someone... Chen Nian.'

text.content:
The markings on the stone wall formed a hidden route. If not for my blood connection with Chen Nian, I would never have sensed the spiritual energy contained within. She was deliberately hiding, yet purposely leaving clues only I could discover.

This contradictory behavior raised a terrifying thought in my heart—Chen Nian's actions were not coerced, but rather deliberately and purposefully advancing deeper into this place. She was guiding me to find something.

Or, she was guiding me to meet her.

At the entrance to the secret passage, a half-person-tall stone tablet stood quietly, its surface covered with moss. I brushed away the dust and saw the second mark left by Chen Nian—

'Page Four'

Three characters, the handwriting more hurried than the previous plum blossom symbol, as if carved in haste. I stared at these three characters, and a flash of insight struck my mind—the fourth page of the Tianji Record!

My breath quickened. Chen Nian knew of the Tianji Record's existence? Why was she pointing to the fourth page? What was recorded on that fourth page that made her risk her life to venture here?

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time carrying an undeniable shock: 'The fourth page... Young Master, even this old servant cannot peer into this page. A certain restriction has been placed upon it, and it will only reveal itself when specific conditions are met. For ten thousand years, countless Tianji Record holders have attempted to unravel this page's secrets, but none have succeeded.'

text.content:
I forcibly suppressed the shock in my heart and continued deeper into the secret passage following Chen Nian's marks. As I advanced, the surrounding air grew increasingly stifling, and the formation patterns on the walls grew denser and denser.

Until I arrived at a crossroads.

Three passages led in different directions, each bearing a symbol left by Chen Nian. I looked closely and found that these three passages were marked 'Danger', 'Death', and 'Change'.

I let out a cold laugh. When did this little girl Chen Nian learn to give people multiple-choice questions?

But after the laugh, my mood became exceptionally heavy. She was only fifteen, yet already drawn into this chess game spanning ten thousand years, possibly having to face the pursuit of both the Holy Sect and the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion alone.

What had she experienced during these three years?

I took a deep breath and forced myself to calm down. The Tianji Record Fragment in my embrace grew slightly warm, as if responding to my anxiety.

I chose 'Change'.

Not because this path was the safest, but because—if Chen Nian was truly setting up a game, she would never choose the most mediocre path.

The moment I stepped into the passage, a chill struck me face to face. Both walls of the passage were covered with dense runes, each rune emitting a ghostly blue glow. I recognized part of them—ancient sealing formations, specifically designed to suppress some powerful being.

And at the end of this sea of runes, a crystal stele stood quietly, emanating a soft yet blinding white light.

I walked slowly toward the crystal stele, each step feeling like treading on knife points. The suppression of spiritual energy grew heavier and heavier, as if invisible eyes were piercing through my soul, examining all my secrets.

However, just as I was about to touch the crystal stele, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently, and a streak of golden light shot forth, colliding violently with the stele's white radiance!

'BOOM—'

The tremendous shockwave sent me flying several zhang, my back slamming heavily against the stone wall. Fighting through the excruciating pain, I looked up and saw a scene that made my heart stop.

After the white light on the crystal stele faded, a passage of text was revealed:

'The Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the enemy of Heavenly Secrets. To lock heaven's fate, veil heaven's secrets, and sever heaven's secrets, only the Lock Key can break them. Ten thousand years ago, the Forty-ninth transformed themselves into the Lock Key, sleeping at this moment, awaiting the opportunity for awakening.'

My pupils contracted sharply.

The Heavenly Fate Lock Key—Chen Nian is the Forty-ninth? No! Chen Nian is this generation's 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key', and that 'Forty-ninth' was the first generation Lock Key from ten thousand years ago, who voluntarily transformed themselves into the Lock Key!

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: 'This old servant remembers now... ten thousand years ago, when the Tianji Record was complete, there was a holder who voluntarily abandoned the Tianji Record's inheritance, transforming themselves into the Lock Key, solely to seal a certain forbidden function of the Tianji Record. That person... her surname was Chen!'

dialogue.content: "Mr. Mo, what forbidden knowledge did that Chen ancestor who voluntarily sacrificed herself ten thousand years ago discover?" My voice was cold, yet carried an inescapable pressure. After a moment of silence, Mr. Mo slowly spoke: "She discovered the truth of the Tianji Record—one of its complete functions is to rewrite Heavenly Fate. The price of rewriting fate is to distort the destiny trajectory of the entire world. The catastrophe ten thousand years ago... was precisely because someone attempted to use this function."

text.content: The text on the altar continued downward, revealing more long-buried secrets: "The Chen family has guarded the secret of the Lock Key for generations. By the forty-ninth generation, the Lock Key will completely awaken. At that time, the Tianji Record will become complete, and an unprecedented resonance will form between the Tianji Record holder and the Lock Key. Once the resonance is complete, Heavenly Fate will be rewritten. Ten thousand years of planning, all for today."

I stared blankly at these words, my mind a complete void. Ten thousand years of planning. Generations of Chen family guardianship. The awakening of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. These words struck my heart like hammers, shattering all my calculations and schemes. So it turns out, I was never the chess master. I never was. From the very beginning, I was a chosen piece. Just like Chen Nian, meticulously arranged into this cross-temporal chess game by someone from ten thousand years ago.

dialogue.content: Just then, a familiar voice came from the depths of the altar: "Brother, you've finally arrived." I looked up sharply to see Chen Nian stepping out from the shadows behind the altar. Her face had matured much from three years ago, yet a faint sorrow lingered between her brows. She looked at me, her eyes glistening with tears: "I'm sorry, Brother. I've involved you in this ten-thousand-year chess game... But this is the only way to save you."

text.content: "Save me?" My voice was somewhat hoarse. "Nian Nian, what are you talking about?" Chen Nian walked slowly to me, reaching out to gently touch the Tianji Record mark on my brow. Her fingertips were cold, yet carried a comforting warmth: "Brother, the Tianji Record on you is incomplete. Every time you use it, it consumes your Heavenly Fate Value. When that value is completely exhausted... you will die." Her voice trembled slightly: "And I am the only person who can break this curse."

My pupils contracted sharply. I wasn't unaware that exhausting one's Heavenly Fate Value meant death, but I had always believed that as long as I was careful enough, I could avoid that day. However, Chen Nian's words revealed a cruel truth: no matter how careful I was, the curse of the Tianji Record would never disappear. Unless... "Unless what?" I grabbed Chen Nian's shoulders, my voice almost a roar. Chen Nian lifted her head, meeting my gaze, her eyes filled with determination: "Unless the Tianji Record is made complete. And the only way to complete it is for me, this Heavenly Fate Lock Key, to fully awaken and resonate with you."

"No!" I stepped back sharply, my voice rising abruptly. "I don't want any complete Tianji Record! I want you to live well! Three years ago, I failed to protect you, which is why the Holy Sect took you—I won't let you sacrifice anything else for me!" Chen Nian's eyes reddened, yet she smiled stubbornly: "Brother, have you forgotten? I am also a descendant of the Chen family. Guarding the Tianji Record and completing it is our family's sacred mission. That ancestor ten thousand years ago willingly sacrificed herself just so this moment could arrive." She reached out and held my wrist: "And now, it's my turn."

I forcefully shook off her hand and turned to leave. However, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated intensely, and a streak of golden light shot out, wrapping around my wrist and binding me firmly in place. "Release me!" I roared. Yet what answered me was a line of small characters newly appearing on the stone tablet: "The Lock Key has awakened; resonance is irreversible. Young Master, please complete your contract with the Lock Key." I was stunned. So from the moment Chen Nian entered the ruins, this contract had become unavoidable.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian walked up to me, gently resting her head against my chest: "Brother, do you know? During these three years, I've been thinking about you constantly. Thinking about the days when you taught me to write. Thinking about the days when you secretly brought me pastries. Thinking about the days when you rushed out to protect me when others bullied me..." Her voice carried a sob: "So this time, let me protect you."

text.content: My eyes grew moist. Three years... I had dreamed of her countless times, thought of her at the edge of life and death countless times. And now she stood before me, yet had to tell me she would trade her life for mine. "Chen Nian." I softly called her name, my voice so hoarse it was barely audible. "Are you truly... prepared?" Chen Nian lifted her head, her eyes brimming with tears yet smiling brilliantly: "From the moment the Holy Sect took me away, I was prepared. Brother, I am not a chess piece to be manipulated. I am a descendant of the Chen family. This choice is my own."

The runes on the altar began flashing madly, and the entire secret passage was vibrating. Chen Nian pulled me toward the center of the altar, where there was a cocoon of pure spiritual energy. Inside the cocoon, a seated figure was faintly visible—that was the residual soul left by the first generation Heavenly Fate Lock Key ten thousand years ago. "Brother, give me your hand." Chen Nian extended her right hand, palm facing up. I didn't move, just watched her quietly. At this moment, I had a thousand words to say, yet nothing came out.

Chen Nian seemed to understand my silence, gently smiling: "Brother, do you remember the promise we made when we were young?" My memories were instantly pulled back to that rainy night many years ago. Two children huddled under a dilapidated eaves, young Chen Nian asked me: "Brother, will we always be together when we grow up?" I nodded seriously: "Always together. Forever." At that time, I didn't know this promise would become today's heaviest shackle.

Chen Nian's eyes glistened with tears, yet she smiled sweetly: "So, Brother. Let me complete this contract. Not for the plan of ten thousand years ago, not for the Chen family's mission—for us to be together forever." Her words were like a blunt knife, carving at my heart piece by piece. I opened my mouth, wanting to refuse, but found my throat blocked by something. The light on the altar grew brighter and brighter, and that spiritual cocoon was slowly opening. The residual soul from ten thousand years ago opened its eyes, its gaze piercing through time and space to fall upon us.

I slowly extended my hand, interlacing my fingers with Chen Nian's. The moment our palms touched, a surge of powerful spiritual energy erupted from our joined hands, sweeping across the entire altar. The Tianji Record Fragment unfolded on its own, and the seal on the fourth page began to loosen. Countless ancient runes scattered like fireflies, weaving a brilliant net of light through the secret passage. And within that net of light, I saw two names—Chen Ji, Chen Nian. They were slowly merging, transforming into a completely new symbol.

"Brother, I see it..." Chen Nian's voice seemed ethereal in the light, "I see the truth of the Tianji Record... I see the plan from ten thousand years ago... I see our shared destiny..." Her tears finally fell, yet she still smiled: "So that's how it is. So from the very beginning, we were the chosen ones." I said nothing, only tightly gripping her hand. Whatever awaited us ahead, I would never let her face it alone again.

The light gradually faded, and the altar returned to calm. I looked down at the Tianji Record Fragment and saw it was changing—the originally incomplete pages were slowly healing, and where the fourth page had been, an unprecedented brilliant golden light was flickering. Chen Nian's complexion was somewhat pale, yet she still tightly held my hand: "Brother... the contract is complete. From now on... our fates are connected." I reached out and pulled her into my embrace, my chin resting on top of her head. At the entrance of the secret passage, the words Chen Nian had written in her own hand were still clear: "Brother, I'll be waiting for you on the fourth page." Now, I have come.

The fourth page of the Tianji Record was completely revealed, and the information left by that Chen family ancestor from ten thousand years ago flooded into my mind like a tide. "Tianji Record Complete Form: Heavenly Fate Remolding. The holder may rewrite the trajectory of fate within a specific range, but each rewrite consumes an equivalent amount of Heavenly Fate Power. The function of the Lock Key is to serve as the source of Heavenly Fate Power—from now on, the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value will be shared by the Lock Key." So that was it. Chen Nian becoming my Lock Key was not for sacrifice, but to share the burden of the Tianji Record's price with me. From now on, the Heavenly Fate Value I consume when using the Tianji Record will be jointly borne by both of us. I lowered my head to look at the girl in my arms, softly asking: "Nian Nian, do you regret it?" Chen Nian lifted her head, breaking into tears yet smiling: "Being able to be with Brother forever, how could I possibly regret?"

However, just at this moment, a cold, sinister laughter came from the depths of the secret passage. That laughter was ear-piercing, as if coming from the Nine幽深渊: "What a touching sibling bond... But do you really think obtaining the Heavenly Fate Lock Key would be so easy?" I looked up sharply, shielding Chen Nian behind me. At the entrance of the secret passage, a black shadow slowly took form. It was an elderly in black robes, with a withered face but eyes gleaming with enchanting幽光. Ling Yuan! The former Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect had actually been lurking here all along!

Ling Yuan walked over slowly, each step pressing on the altar's runes, extinguishing those newly awakened spiritual patterns one by one. His gaze fell on the Tianji Record Fragment, his eyes filled with greed: "This old one has waited for this day for eight hundred years. Back then, the Tianji Record chose your ancestor instead of me—I have always nursed a grievance about this. Now... the Tianji Record will finally belong to me." I sneered: "Old thing, do you think you can succeed?" Ling Yuan burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the secret passage: "Boy, do you think completing the contract means you can rest easy? The Lock Key has just awakened, at its most vulnerable—and I have been waiting for a long time!"

I tightly gripped the Tianji Record Fragment, sensing the power surging within it. After the contract was completed, a golden vein had appeared on the fragment—that was the mark of shared fate between Chen Nian and me. I could clearly sense her existence—her heartbeat, her breath, her emotions. "Nian Nian, step behind me." My voice was calm, yet carried undeniable authority. Chen Nian didn't move; instead, she stood shoulder to shoulder with me: "Brother, this time let me stand with you." I glanced at her, seeing the determination in her eyes. At this moment, I suddenly realized—she was no longer that little girl who needed my protection. She was a descendant of the Chen family, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, a partner whose fate was bound to mine.

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, studying us: "Interesting... The Lock Key has just awakened and dares to fight side by side with the Tianji Record holder? Very well, let this destined couple die together!" Before his words even finished, he formed a seal with one hand, and a streak of black spiritual light shot toward us. That spiritual light contained terrifying spiritual energy fluctuations—a full-power strike from a peak Transcendent Transformation cultivator! I didn't dodge, but raised the Tianji Record Fragment high above my head. The golden vein on the fragment suddenly lit up, and I softly intoned: "Tianji—Rewrite!" A streak of faint light shot out from the fragment, colliding violently with Ling Yuan's black spiritual light. The two forces held stalemate above the altar for a moment, before both annihilated simultaneously.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly: "You... your Tianji Record actually managed to block my attack? Impossible! The lock just awakened, your coordination couldn't possibly be this seamless!"

text.content: "I curled my lips slightly, revealing a mocking smile: 'Old thing, did you think I spent three years laying plans just to find my sister?' Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply: 'What do you mean?' I didn't answer, only raising my left hand. In my palm, a purple spiritual pattern slowly rotated—it was the mark of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. 'Do you think the Holy Sect let Chen Nian enter the ruins alone?' My voice was soft, yet like a blade piercing straight into Ling Yuan's heart. 'Because from the very beginning, the Holy Sect was my chess piece.' Ling Yuan's face instantly turned ashen."

Just then, a commotion echoed from deep within the secret passage. A purple figure drifted forward—it was Ye Qing, the Saint of the Demonic Path. Her face wore an amused smile as her gaze swept over Ling Yuan: 'Oh my, the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, hiding in this wretched place?' Ling Yuan's expression completely darkened: 'You... actually colluded with the Demonic Path!' I laughed lightly: 'Colluded? Old Sect Master Ling, you're being unfair. Saint Ye Qing is my cooperative partner—we share an equal and mutually beneficial relationship. As for you—being the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect yet coveting the sect's supreme treasures and scheming against sect disciples, how shall we settle this account?'"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's face contorted into a grimace, eight hundred years of patience and scheming transforming into a raging fury in that instant: 'Good! Good one, Chen Ji! Good pair of siblings! Today, this old man will show you what true strength means!' He formed seals with both hands, spiritual energy surging around him like a tide, the entire secret passage trembling violently. However, just as he was about to strike, a cold sword light shot from the passage entrance, heading straight for his heart!"

text.content: Forced to interrupt his incantation, Ling Yuan dodged sideways. The sword light grazed his sleeve, leaving a bottomless gash in the stone wall. 'Su Qingyao?' Ling Yuan's expression turned extremely unsightly. At the passage entrance stood Su Qingyao in white robes, sword in hand, her expression cold and stern as frost: 'Sect Master Ling, you have tremendous audacity. How dare you harm sect disciples in the forbidden grounds?' I looked at Su Qingyao, slightly surprised in my heart. She had arrived earlier than I anticipated—she must have been monitoring my movements in secret all along."

Ling Yuan surveyed his surroundings, realizing he had fallen into an encirclement. Though he was a peak Nascent Soul realm expert, facing a coordinated assault from the Tianji Record holder, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the Saint of the Demonic Path, and the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, he had no choice but to tread carefully. 'Fine... fine...' He repeated two 'fines', his voice chillingly sinister. 'Today's matter, this old man will remember. Chen Ji, do you think this is the end? I will obtain the complete form of the Tianji Record!' Before the words even finished, his figure turned into black smoke and vanished into the depths of the secret passage."

I didn't pursue. Not because I didn't want to, but because I couldn't. Ling Yuan had built his foundations in Tianqing Sect for eight hundred years, with deep roots and numerous means. Fighting him to the death here would only result in mutual destruction. Besides—I lowered my gaze to the Tianji Record Fragment in my hand, a new calculation forming in my mind. The contract had just been completed, and the resonance between Chen Nian and myself remained unstable. Forcibly using the complete functions of the Tianji Record now would only backfire."

Su Qingyao sheathed her sword and walked to my side, looking at Chen Nian with a complicated gaze: 'Is this your sister?' I nodded: 'Chen Nian, this is Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect. Also... the person who has been secretly helping me.' Chen Nian obediently bowed: 'Hello, Sister Su. Thank you for taking care of my brother these three years.' Su Qingyao's expression stiffened slightly, then returned to calm: 'You're too kind.' I noticed the complex emotions flickering in her eyes and sighed inwardly, but said nothing more."

Ye Qing watched the scene with a smile, speaking meaningfully: 'Chen Ji, you sure have many romantic interests. First Su Qingyao the Senior Fellow, now the Lock Key sister... Tsk tsk.' I ignored her teasing and looked at Chen Nian instead: 'Nian Nian, how long have you been in these ruins? Where are the people from the Holy Sect?' Chen Nian's expression darkened slightly: 'I shook off the Holy Sect people. They wanted to use me to open a certain forbidden ground, but I didn't let them succeed.' She paused. 'However... they should still be wandering around the outskirts of the ruins. Sect Master Ling's appearance probably has something to do with them.'"

My brow furrowed. Ling Yuan was colluding with the Holy Sect? That was a new discovery. It seemed the internal problems of Tianqing Sect were far more complex than I had imagined. 'Saint Ye Qing.' I turned to the purple-robed woman. 'Can you find out the Holy Sect's true purpose here?' Ye Qing's playful expression faded, a solemn glint flickering in her eyes: 'I came specifically to tell you about this. The Holy Sect's journey here wasn't just about the Lock Key—they truly want something sealed deep within these ruins. It's said to be... related to the Eye of Heavenly Way.' My pupils contracted sharply."

The Eye of Heavenly Way. The ultimate villain that would only be revealed in Volume Eight, had actually extended its reach to this place. I took a deep breath, forcing myself to remain calm. The situation was developing far faster than I had anticipated. What I thought was merely a search for Chen Nian had unexpectedly pulled me into such an enormous scheme. 'It seems...' I murmured to myself, 'this chess game is far more complex than I imagined.' The Tianji Record Fragment in my embrace grew slightly warm, as if responding to my thoughts."

I raised my head and looked at everyone present—Chen Nian, my sister, the Lock Key bound by fate; Su Qingyao, the beauty who had been secretly helping me; Ye Qing, the Saint of the Demonic Path, my business partner. Three women, three identities, yet all standing on my side. 'Let's go.' I turned toward the passage exit. 'This place isn't safe to linger. Although Ling Yuan has retreated for now, he won't let this matter rest. We need to find a secure location to thoroughly discuss our next plans.' Chen Nian stayed close by my side, her small hand gripping my sleeve: 'Brother, we won't be separated again, right?' I looked down at her, my gaze gentle: 'Never again. From now on, we'll always be together.'"

The group passed through the secret passage and returned to the core area of the ruins. The moment we stepped out of the passage, the fourth page of the Tianji Record Fragment fully unfurled, countless golden runes scattering like fireflies, weaving a magnificent star map in the void. Within the star map, a line of ancient text slowly emerged: 'Tianji Record is one-tenth complete. To unlock the next stage, find the remaining nine fragments.' I stared at these words, my lips curving slightly upward. One-tenth? Though still far from enough, at the very least—it was a good start. At the secret passage entrance, Chen Nian's handwritten words slowly faded away in the light. 'Brother, I'll be waiting for you on the fourth page'—this promise, I had fulfilled. But the greater chess game had only just begun."
